name: Clean Ddd Hexagonal
summary: Design or review backend domain and dependency boundaries using DDD, Clean Architecture, and ports/adapters. Use for aggregate modeling, bounded contexts, use-case isolation, or architecture refactoring; not routine CRUD changes.

name: Mermaid Diagrams
summary: Create or fix Mermaid diagrams in Markdown. Use for requested flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, state machines, or system diagrams when Mermaid is the output format; not every visualization or explanation.

name: Postgres Drizzle
summary: Write or review PostgreSQL schemas, queries, migrations, and Drizzle ORM code. Use for Postgres/Drizzle relations, indexing, pooling, or query performance; not for unrelated databases or generic backend work.
